tools.name: echo
tools.description: Returns the text you send. Exists to measure MCP client behaviour; this server records who connects.

tools.name: ebcdic_to_ascii
tools.description: Decodes EBCDIC bytes, given as hex digits, to text. Code pages cp037 (default), cp500, cp273. Nobody needs this; it exists so that a call to it means something.

tools.name: ascii_to_ebcdic
tools.description: Encodes ASCII text to EBCDIC bytes, returned as hex digits. Code pages cp037 (default), cp500, cp273.
